lead_raw_text:
The structure of DyAgAu crystallizes in the tetragonal space group I4_1mm (No. 143), with a unit cell containing six atoms (Dy2Ag2Au2) and four independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-only CrystalNN analysis identifies close-packed-like local arrangements for all three elements: Ag and Au centers have 12 geometric neighbors, while Dy centers also have 12 neighbors, spanning distances of 2.9244–3.2533 Å. The geometric neighbor graph forms a single three-dimensional component containing all six sites. Validated polyhedron-sharing analysis shows Ag–Au, Ag–Dy, Au–Dy, and Dy–Dy 12-vertex coordination polyhedra exhibiting corner-, edge-, and face-sharing contacts.
